what: digital-gain ladder at 115 cm, bypass vs cancel, one frozen source
corrections_applied: tonality is single-window spectral prominence (max 1/3-octave band over the band median). It has no time-growth component, so it cannot separate a steady resonance from a growing one.

Therefore the earlier "stable boundary interval" and "the canceller buys about 3 dB" are WITHDRAWN. What remains is the observation that the two modes cross the spectral alert threshold (>12 dB) at different gain levels.
The last step is -2 -> 0 dB, i.e. 2 dB, not 3 dB.
provenance: reconstructed from the run log of ladder_20250511-190601 after the save bug was found: the normal-completion path did not append its record, so ladder.json was incomplete. The captures on the board were not re-run; the -2 dB bypass run was the point where that mode stopped, so 0 dB bypass was never executed.
protection_state: bit22 = 0 and all four saturating counters 0 at every level in both modes
deviation: the captain asked for 10 s per level; the driver caps the source at 131072 samples (2.68 s) and the capture is the last 16384 frames, so each level ran 2.6 s with the source active through the capture window
not_claimed: audible loudness and listener SPL not measured in this batch
